# Navimower Map Card 0.3.6-beta6

## Fixed

- Fix a Companion App freeze when OpenStreetMap underlay is enabled together with Multi mower view. The OSM renderer no longer observes and mutates the same Multi mower SVG layer in a self-triggering loop.
- Render Multi mower OSM tiles in a dedicated sibling SVG layer so normal Multi mower redraws cannot recursively trigger the underlay renderer.
- Make OpenStreetMap settings reliably visible in the Visual Editor under a dedicated **Map underlay** section.

## Compatibility

OpenStreetMap remains opt-in and still requires a validated Navimower georeference. Existing cards with no underlay configured are unchanged.
